  <gallery>
    <tool name="CalculateField" type="function" toolboxalias="management">
      <displayname>Calculate Field</displayname>
      <description>Calculates the values of a field for a feature class, feature layer, or raster catalog.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Buffer" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Buffer</displayname>
      <description>Creates buffer polygons around input features to a specified distance.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Near" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Near</displayname>
      <description>Calculates distance and additional proximity information between the input features and the closest feature in another layer or feature class.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="SpatialJoin" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Spatial Join</displayname>
      <description>Joins attributes from one feature to another
based on the spatial relationship. The target features and the joined attributes from the join features are written to the output feature class.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Intersect" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Intersect</displayname>
      <description>Computes a geometric intersection of the input features. Features or portions of features which overlap in all layers and/or feature classes will be written to the output feature class.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="EmpiricalBayesianKriging" type="function" toolboxalias="ga">
      <displayname>Empirical Bayesian Kriging</displayname>
      <description>Empirical Bayesian kriging is an interpolation method that accounts for the error in estimating the underlying semivariogram through repeated simulations.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="KernelDensity" type="function" toolboxalias="sa">
      <displayname>Kernel Density</displayname>
      <description>Calculates a magnitude per unit area from point or polyline features using a kernel function to fit a smoothly tapered surface to each point or polyline.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="OptimizedHotSpotAnalysis" type="script" toolboxalias="stats">
      <displayname>Optimized Hot Spot Analysis</displayname>
      <description>Given incident points or weighted features (points or polygons), creates a map of statistically significant hot and cold spots using the Getis-Ord Gi* statistic. It evaluates the characteristics of the input feature class to produce optimal results.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Statistics" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Summary Statistics</displayname>
      <description>Calculates summary statistics for field(s) in a table.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Union" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Union</displayname>
      <description>Computes a geometric union of the input features. All features and their attributes will be written to the output feature class.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="AddField" type="function" toolboxalias="management">
      <displayname>Add Field</displayname>
      <description>Adds a new field to a table or the table of a feature class, feature layer, raster catalog, and/or rasters with attribute tables.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Sort" type="function" toolboxalias="management">
      <displayname>Sort</displayname>
      <description>Reorders, in ascending or descending order, records in a feature class or table based on one or multiple fields. The reordered result is written to a new dataset.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Dissolve" type="function" toolboxalias="management">
      <displayname>Dissolve</displayname>
      <description>Aggregates features based on specified attributes.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Merge" type="function" toolboxalias="management">
      <displayname>Merge</displayname>
      <description>Combines multiple input datasets of the same data type into a single, new output dataset. This tool can combine point, line, or polygon feature classes or tables.</description>
    </tool>
    <tool name="Clip" type="function" toolboxalias="analysis">
      <displayname>Clip</displayname>
      <description>Extracts input features that overlay the clip features.</description>
    </tool>
